senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rude, ill behaved.
2 Haughty, vain, puffed up.
3 Raised, elevated.
4 Excited, intense.
m. (-तः)
A king's wrestler.
E.
उद् above, हन to hurt or injure, affix क्त; ह becomes घ.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Haughty, proud, high minded.
E.
उद्धत raised, मनस्क minded.

n. (-त्वं)
Pride, arrogance.
E.
उद्धत, मनस्क having a mind, and त्व abstract aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Pride, haughtiness.
2 Elevation.
E.
उद् before हन to strike, affix क्तिन्.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Who or what blows.
m. (मः)
1 Breathing hard, panting.
2 Blowing, sounding.
E.
उद् before ध्मा to blow, affix श.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Who or what drinks.
E.
उद् before धे to drink, श aff.

mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्ती-र्त्तृ)
1 Who raises or lifts up.
2 A sharer, a coheir.
3 Who recovers property.
E.
उद् before हृ to take, तृन् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Raising or lifting any thing.
2 Eradicating a tree, &c.
3 Exterminating, destroying.
4 Taking a part or share.
5 Vomiting, bringing up.
6 Final emancipation.
E.
उद् up, हृ to take, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Raising, elevating.
2 Sharing, dividing.
E.
उद् before धृ to have, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be raised up.
2 To be given up.
E.
उद् before हरणीय to be taken.

m. (-र्षः)
1 A festival, especially religious.
2 Great joy.
E.
उद् much, हर्ष happiness.

n. (-णं)
Erection of the hair of the body.
E.
उद् much, हृष to be happy, and ल्युट् affix; occasioned by great pleasure.

m. (-वः)
1 A festival, a holiday.
2 Sacrificial fire.
3 The name of a person, the friend and councillor of KṚṢṆA.
E.
उद् reverse, धु to feel pain, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Gone up, ascended.
2 Vomited.
n. (-नं)
A furnace or fire place.
E.
उद, धा to have or hold, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-त्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Vomited.
m. (-न्तः)
An elephant out of rut.
E.
उद् up, and ध्मा to breathe or blow, affix क्त.

m. (-रः)
Raising, elevating, lifting up.
2 Debt, especially a debt not bearing interest.
3 A portion, a share.
4 A deduction, a part to be set aside.
5 Recovering property.
6 Extracting, quoting.
n. (-रं)
A fire place.
f. (-रा)
A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गुडूची.
E.
उद् up, धृ to have, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what raises or lifts.
E.
उद् before हृ to take, वुञ् aff.

m. (-गः)
Partition, division of shares.
E.
उद्धार and विभाग dividing.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Heavy.
2 Thick, gross.
3 Firm.
E.
उद् and धुर a burden.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Shaken off, fallen from or off.
2 Tossed up, scattered above.
E.
उद् and धूत trembling.

n. (-णं)
Horripilation.
E.
उद् up, धूष to shine, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (तः-ता-तं)
1 Raised, drawn up, as water from a well, &c.
2 Pulled up or out, eradicated or broken off.
3 Lifted up.
4 Raised, elevated.
5 Thrown up or upwards.
6 Vomited.
7 Separated, set apart.
8 Divided, partitioned.
9 Recovered.
10 Uncovered.
11 Dispersed, scattered.
12 Extracted, selected, taken from or out of.
13 Holding, containing.
E.
उद् up, धृ to take, and क्त. aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 One who has received his share.
2 That from which a share has been deducted.
E.
उद्धृत and उद्धार a share.

m. (-द्ध्यः)
A river.
E.
उञ्झ to go, क्यप् affix, deriv. irr.

n. (-नं)
A furnace or fire place.
E.
उद्, ध्मा to blow, and ल्युट् aff.
